description.value:
You must be wielding at least one lightweapon or vibroweapon to cast this power, or it fails. You may throw two weapons, each carving a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line from yourself, or throw a single weapon along one such line and redirect it into a second identical line within range. Every creature in an affected line must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 5d8 damage of the weapon's type plus 5d8 force damage, halved on a success; a creature caught in more than one line is affected only once. The weapons then return to your hand.

Cast with a slot of 8th level or higher, both the weapon damage and the force damage increase by 1d8 per slot level beyond 7th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 7
